# Handyman of Southern Utah

> Handyman Services in Washington County, UT. James and Casidy take on deck repair and paint, water heater installs, ceiling fans, mini splits and pavers. Fast to reply, on time, and they clean up after themselves.

Note: this is a preview site built by Handled (handleditforyou.com), not yet the business's live website.

## Contact
- Phone: (435) 868-8545
- Website: https://handleditforyou.com/demo/handyman-of-southern-utah/
- Google rating: 5.0 stars from 10 reviews

## Services
- Decks: Worn wooden decks repaired and painted to look new again.
- Water heaters: New water heaters installed, fast.
- Fans & fixtures: Ceiling fans hung and loose fixtures tightened.
- Mini splits & pavers: Mini split AC installs and brick paver projects.

## Service area
- Washington County, UT

## Questions customers ask
- **Do you install water heaters?** Yes. A customer needed a new water heater installed and said they got back extremely fast and did a wonderful job.
- **Do you repair decks?** Yes. One customer had a well-worn wooden deck repaired and painted, and said it looked better than new.
- **What else do you take on?** Customers mention ceiling fans, loose fixtures, a mini split AC, brick pavers and a flat roof repair.
- **Can you help with an urgent fix?** One host had an urgent issue on a Sunday, with new guests checking in, and couldn't say enough good things about them.
- **What areas do you serve?** We serve Washington County. Not sure if you're in range? Give us a call.
